inheritance_policy: H1-H5 register definitions, ID5, stable FTDI U2D2 serial path, rates, interlocks, P01-P03 motion definitions, zero, and the ±90 degree software gate are inherited from experiment_config.json; the required 1 ms USB latency declaration and native-640 paired iPhone media contract are declared in this overlay; B1 executes only H1/H2 and expands the frozen settings into every episode manifest/readback

fixture.payload_commonality: same 3D-printed weight design is used for every weighted V5 configuration
fixture.mass_property_status: PDF inertia remains preliminary; measured masses for the 2026-08-26 recollection are two complete 44 g payloads including their pins plus one 22 g link; recompute link inertia from geometry before identification

iphone_media_capture.capture_scope: one continuously connected service; one recording session per retained B1 H1/H2 motion episode (two pilots, 18 calibration episodes, and 10 held-out episodes); preparation-only recenter records are not campaign media episodes; each retained episode has paired labeled and unlabeled derived MP4s, with display_code plus a dynamic phase label burned only into the labeled copy; the run-level full videos concatenate the 30 captured episodes in campaign order and intentionally omit STOP-to-next-START gaps; video/ and keyframes/ artifact paths are relative to each episode folder, while media/ paths are relative to the run root

data_policy.source: new physical measurements collected for V5
data_policy.collection_scope: B1 at ±80 mm only; stop before fixture change
data_policy.split_policy: P01-P03 calibration under H1-H2 for three repeats; untouched P06 held-out under H1-H2 for five repeats
data_policy.held_out_policy: P06 is collected and frozen but must not influence fitting, bounds, timing treatment, filtering, or model selection
